title: Communicative On-Policy Distillation: Distilling Black-Box Teacher Capabilities through Communication for Long-Horizon Tasks
abstract: arXiv:2611.23673v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) is a powerful paradigm for improving language-model agents on long-horizon tasks, yet its conventional formulation relies on teacher logits that text-only black- box models do not expose. To address this limitation, we introduce Communicative On-Policy Distillation (COPD), which uses natural-language communication as a medium for distilling a stronger model's capabilities into a smaller student. During task execution, the student au- tonomously decides when to consult a black-box teacher and formulates open-ended natural- language requests without predefined question templates or intervention schedules. Successful student-teacher interactions are retained as privileged references to supervise fresh adviser-free student rollouts through on-policy self-distillation, jointly with task-reward reinforcement learning. translated_title: 通信式在策略蒸馏：通过通信为长时程任务蒸馏黑盒教师模型的能力
translated_abstract: 在策略蒸馏是一种提升语言模型智能体在长时程任务上表现的强大范式，然而其传统形式依赖于教师模型的 logits，而仅支持文本的黑盒模型并不会暴露这些信息。为解决这一局限，我们提出了通信式在策略蒸馏，它以自然语言通信为媒介，将更强大模型的能力蒸馏到更小的学生模型中。在任务执行过程中，学生模型自主决定何时咨询黑盒教师，并在没有预定义问题模板或干预时间表的情况下提出开放式的自然语言请求。成功的学生-教师交互会被保留为特权参考，通过在策略自蒸馏来监督学生在无顾问情况下的全新推演，并与任务奖励强化学习联合进行。在 CAMG-II 上，COPD 取得了最强黑盒 OPD 基线 2.46 倍的增益。
tldr: 提出通信式在策略蒸馏（COPD），以自然语言通信为媒介，让学生模型自主决定何时向黑盒教师提问，并将成功的师生交互用于在策略自蒸馏与任务奖励强化学习相结合的训练，从而在长时程任务上取得最强黑盒蒸馏基线 2.46 倍的增益。
en_tdlr: Communicative On-Policy Distillation (COPD) uses natural-language communication as the distillation medium, letting a student agent autonomously consult a black-box teacher and leveraging successful interactions for on-policy self-distillation combined with task-reward reinforcement learning, achieving 2.46× the gain of the strongest black-box OPD baseline on long-horizon tasks.
